title: Explain Entity Framework Core and its approaches.
description: Understand EF Core and Code First vs Database First.

data.text: **Question:** Explain Entity Framework Core and its approaches.

Entity Framework Core is an ORM for .NET that enables working with databases using .NET objects. It supports Code First (define model in code, generate database) and Database First (generate model from existing database) approaches.

**Code First:**
- Define model classes in C#
- EF Core creates database schema
- Migrations manage schema changes
- Best for new projects
- Full control over model design

**Database First:**
- Reverse-engineer existing database
- Generate model classes from schema
- Best for legacy databases
- Uses Scaffold-DbContext command
- Can be maintained with partial classes
